artworks.title: George Jeffreys, Earl of Flint, Viscount Weikham
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man. He has long, curly hair that flows over his shoulders and frames his face. His facial features include arched eyebrows, a long nose, and a slightly pointed chin, with a composed expression. He is wearing an elaborately decorated coat with floral patterns and a lace cravat visible at the neck. The background is dark and featureless, focusing attention on the subject. The portrait is framed within an oval border.

artworks.title: George, Lord Jeffreys
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual from the chest up, depicted in an upright position. The person has a composed and slightly direct gaze, with prominent facial features, including a well-defined nose and lips. The hair is long, cascading in voluminous curls that frame the face. The person is dressed in ornate clothing, featuring intricate patterns and detailed fabric. There is no visible jewelry, but the clothing itself is richly decorated. The background is a simple, unadorned dark backdrop.

artworks.title: The Great Age of Henry Jenkins
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of an elderly man with a long beard, deep-set eyes, and a prominent nose. He is wearing a large brimmed hat and period clothing with visible buttons on his coat. There is an inscription around the image. The background is plain with no additional objects or scenery.

artworks.title: John Jewell, Bishop of Salisbury
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is an image of a man shown from the chest up. The man is facing forward, with a slight tilt of his head. His facial features include a stern expression with deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and a small goatee. He wears a distinctive hat with a flat, wide top and a pointed front edge. His hair is not visible due to the headwear. The clothing consists of a dark, voluminous robe with a prominent collar, over a lighter-colored garment underneath that features a high collar. The background features a textured pattern that appears to be etched or drawn in lines. There are no visible accessories or objects being held by the man. The lower part of the image contains text identifying the man as "IOANNES IVELLVS EPISC."

artworks.title: King John
artworks.description: The image shows a man in royal attire holding a scepter in his right hand and an orb in his left. He has long wavy hair, a full beard, and a mustache. He wears a crown with floral decorations and a cloak with ermine fur lining. The background has ornate designs and inscriptions.

artworks.title: King John of England
artworks.description: The engraving shows a man from the waist up facing forward. He holds a scepter in his right hand and a globus cruciger in his left. He has a beard, mustache, shoulder-length wavy hair, and wears a crown, ornate robe, and fur trimming. The design includes heraldic shields and an oval frame with inscriptions labeling him as King John of England. The background is a detailed yet neutral space.

artworks.title: John, Archduke of Austria
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. He has a pronounced mustache, beard, and refined expression. His hair is short and wavy, styled neatly. He is wearing intricate armor with a large ruff collar. The portrait is framed with an oval border with an illustration of a ring encircled at the bottom. The background has a patterned texture. Text surrounds the oval frame.

artworks.title: Johan the Elder of Nassau
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length depiction of a man. The man has mature facial features with a prominent nose, arched eyebrows, and deep-set eyes. His expression is calm, with a thick beard and mustache, and his hair is styled with waves and volume. He is dressed in elaborately detailed clothing with ornate patterns and intricate lacework around the collar. The man holds a cylindrical object in his right hand, near his chest. The background features a densely hatched oval containing Latin text, framed within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Johan the Elder of Nassau
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man, showing him from the chest up. He is positioned facing slightly to his right while looking directly at the viewer. The man has a well-defined brow, deep-set eyes, and a slight upward curl to his lips. His facial hair consists of a neat mustache and a small pointed beard. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair. He wears an elaborate outfit with a high, starched lace ruff around his neck, a patterned fabric draped over his shoulders, and an ornate garment on his body. The background is circular with a textured pattern, surrounded by an inscription. The image is monochromatic, suggesting it is an engraving or etching.

artworks.title: Joachim Ernest, Elector of Brandenburg
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man. He is shown from the chest up, facing slightly to the left in a three-quarter view. The man has wavy hair styled back, a full mustache, and a short pointed beard. His expression is neutral and he looks directly at the viewer. The man is dressed in ornate, period-style clothing with intricate patterns and embellishments. He wears a high collar with lace, detailed embroidery, and a sash draped over one shoulder. The background features a finely engraved decorative oval surround with inscribed text along the outer edge, framing the portrait.

artworks.title: Joachim Ernest, Elector of Brandenburg
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the waist up in a frontal position. He has distinct facial features including a mustache and short, curly hair. The man wears a suit of armor with a ruffled collar extending above the armor's top edge. One hand rests on his hip, and the other holds a baton-like object. A sword is visible at his waist. Next to him is a helmet with feathers on top. The background features draped fabric and an ornate shield or coat of arms on the wall.

artworks.title: Johan Ernest of Nassau
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper torso of a man. He is positioned at an angle facing slightly to his left, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a well-groomed mustache and beard, with short, wavy hair styled back from his forehead. He wears a detailed, historical outfit that includes a richly patterned garment with a high, elaborate lace ruff around his neck. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by him. The background features a circular frame enclosing the portrait with text inscribed around it, which names the individual as Ioannes Ernestus Com. A Nassau.

artworks.title: John Ernest of Nassau
artworks.description: This engraving depicts the upper half of a man's body. The man is slightly angled to the left, with his head turned toward the viewer. He has a mustache and beard, and his hair is short and wavy. He wears a high-collared ruff and an ornate garment with detailed patterns on the sleeves. The man is inside an oval frame surrounded by text. The background is finely hatched in a traditional style.

artworks.title: John Ernest, Jr., Duke of Saxony
artworks.artist: Willem Hondius after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows a man with prominent facial features, including a mustache and a pointed beard. He has voluminous curly hair, styled around his face and down to his neck. He is dressed in an embroidered garment and a lace collar that extends over his shoulders. He appears to be holding a decorative object near his chest. The background features a patterned, oval-shaped frame with Latin text.

artworks.title: Johan Louis of Nassau
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the chest up. The person has a smooth, youthful face with well-defined features and wavy hair styled away from their face. They are facing forward, looking directly at the viewer. The person is wearing a high-collared garment with intricate lacework on the collar and detailed patterning on the clothing. The background is plain with a textured pattern within a circular frame and text surrounding the edge of the image.

artworks.title: Johan Louis of Nassau
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man displayed in an oval frame. He is facing slightly to his right with a direct gaze. The man has a neat mustache and short, wavy hair styled back. He wears a high-collared, ornate outfit with intricate lace and embroidered patterns. The clothing suggests wealth or nobility. The background has textured lines and the frame includes Latin inscriptions for identification or commemoration. Borders with text and decorations surround the image.

artworks.title: John Maurice, Count of Nassau
artworks.artist: Pieter Claesz Soutman after Gerrit van Honthorst
artworks.description: The image depicts a black and white portrait showing the upper body of a man in historical attire. He has a long, narrow face with pronounced cheekbones, a pointed beard, and a mustache. The man has wavy, shoulder-length hair. He is dressed in richly adorned armor with ornate decorations on the shoulders and a fabric scarf across his chest. The man is not wearing jewelry or holding any objects. The background features an oval frame with decorative text surrounding the portrait, situated within a rectangular piece of paper with script at the bottom. The style suggests a classical print or engraving.

artworks.title: John William, Duke of Cleves
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man with distinctive facial features. He is wearing a ruffled collar with fur-trimmed attire beneath and a wide-brimmed hat adorned with intricate detailing. In the background, there is an oval frame with Latin text and decorative elements, including a small cherub figure at the top.

artworks.title: Hadrianus Junius
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man turned to the left. The man's profile reveals facial features including a prominent nose, a beard, and a mustache. He has a serious expression and is wearing a flat cap over his relatively short hair. The clothing consists of a fur-lined coat with intricate detailing on the collar and a garment underneath that is not fully visible. The man is not depicted holding any objects, and there is no visible jewelry. Surrounding the figure is an oval frame adorned with a braided pattern. The background is lightly shaded with diagonal lines, and the upper right corner contains a patterned shield and the year "1562" is inscribed. The portrait includes stylized text beneath it.

artworks.title: Anne, Duc de Joyeuse
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving showing the upper body of a man turned slightly to his left. He is depicted in a formal pose with an expression of composed confidence. The man has a prominent mustache and goatee, with wavy hair that is styled upwards and slightly back. He is wearing an elaborately large ruffled neck collar, along with a buttoned garment featuring a vertical row of ornate buttons and a smooth, glossy texture. Surrounding him is a decorative border with the name "LE DVC DE IOYEUSE" inscribed at the top. The background of the portrait is plain. Beneath the portrait, there is a decorative border with cursive script text.

artworks.title: Anne, Duc de Joyeuse
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man shown in a semi-profile facing the viewer. The man's facial features are detailed, including a forehead, cheeks, and a goatee with a mustache. His hair is wavy and styled upwards. He wears a large ruff collar and ornate armor at the shoulders. An earring is visible in one ear. The background features an oval frame with inscribed text. Below the portrait, there is a passage of text with decorative flourishes.

artworks.title: Equestrian Portrait of Don Juan de Austria
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse. The person holds the reins with one hand and a marshal's baton with the other. The person has a stern expression, long hair, and wears a feathered hat and elaborate clothing. The background shows a town with ships in the water.

artworks.title: Joachim Jung
artworks.description: The image features the upper half of a person's body in a portrait style. The person is slightly turned to the side with one hand visible resting against the chest. They have an aged face with notable facial features, including long wavy hair, a full beard, and mustache with a grayish hue. The person is dressed in formal attire with a high ruffled collar and a buttoned jacket. The background shows a patterned surface and shelves of books. The portrait is encircled by an oval frame with inscriptions surrounding it.

artworks.title: Robert Junius
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a chair with only his upper body visible. He is facing slightly to the left, with his left arm resting on a surface. The man has an angular face with prominent cheekbones, a pointed beard and mustache, and shoulder-length hair. He is dressed formally in a robe or coat over a white shirt. In front of him is a table with stacked books. The background has a textured pattern, and there is a text panel at the bottom with the name "Robertus Junius" and other script details.
